title: test(research): bind V45 helper and private-buffer events
body:
## Summary

Bind the actual helper249/private953 events in both final PR2979 providers to their source gates and selected rank-seven residual recipe. This takes the direct-event part of [PR3006](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3006)'s handoff.

```text
authenticate sources and regenerate transport / emitter / adapters
match 73 direct events against source operations and scalar clocks
bind selected inverse wrappers and six climbs on all 512 columns
```

The opt-in package preserves exact sources, a deterministic receipt, semantic controls and remaining obligations. [Scope and reproduction](research/rank7-v45-event-binding/README.md). Scientific base `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, priority revision 6; construction head `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** opposite phase changes to the two wrapper literals preserve their native operator equality. **After:** the exact selected-source recipe binding rejects that gauge-equivalent replacement. This is a verifier control, not a production defect.
- Both genuine providers pass 73 direct events per orientation, including 63 scalar operations, six climbs, two wrappers and private allocation/free. Regenerated native check/adapter receipts match PR2979 exactly. Moving a covered operation across another scalar, omitted cleanup and altered wrapper/frame/rank controls reject without checksum shortcuts.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 / NumPy 1.26.4 replay, nine behavioral groups, optimized warning-as-error replay, Ruff and a separate internal read-only review pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-v45-event-binding`.
- [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18978584). Credit Dumitrean, Kothe, Hale, Diviney, Tekalign, icekylinx, Thakrar, Richardson and the retained source lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only one new opt-in research package. Frozen sources, shared production code and the selected frontier remain unchanged. Direct event agreement does not prove return-to-zero or complete physical execution. Other registers' native/warp dependencies, ownership/storage, precision, supplier/outer release and inherited all-size obligations remain open. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.
